newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Leplats surges on Amplats merger details.
newsitem.headline: Leplats surges on Amplats merger details.

text.p: Lebowa Platinum Mines Ltd (Leplats) surged nearly 30 percent in active early trade on Wednesday after Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd (Amplats) detailed the planned merger of its operations.

Leplats opened at a two-year high of 450 cents a share after Amplats announced late Tuesday details of plans to combine itself and its three platinum mines into a single listed entity with Rustenburg Platinum Holdings Ltd as the vehicle.
Leplats closed Tuesday's trade, before the announcement, at 330 cents per share.
In the first hour of trade on Wednesday Leplats shares changed hands in deals worth 5.39 million rand. It was last trading at 415 cents in a volume of 2.97 million shares.
Rusplats shares opened lower on Wednesday and by 0930 GMT were trading at 73.50 rand a share, 300 cents down.
Dealers and analysts said under the scheme of arrangements -- which will see Rusplats utilised as the vehicle for the merger -- Leplats shares were being offered at a premium to the share price.

"It is an intricate system but the point is that Lebowa is being offered at basically a premium on its share price. I would guess that that price has gone up to where people are taking profits now," a platinum analyst said.
Dealers said they expected downward movement in Rusplats.

"Rusplats is going to be the vehicle going forward, so there is going to be a bit of downward price section in Rusplats and you are going to have an upward price section in the underlying price counters by the scheme of arrangement," one dealer said.
Potgietersrust Platinums Ltd (PPRust) shares were up 40 cents at 29.85 rand. They earlier touched a new year high of 30.50 rand.
Amplats also touched a new year high of 35 rand before retreating to 34.10 rand, after closing Tuesday at 34 rand.

Amplats said on Tuesday that after the restructuring, it will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Rusplats and Potgietersrust Platinums Ltd (PPRust) and Lebowa Platinum Mines Ltd (Leplats) will be 100 percent owned by Amplats and Rusplats.
As a result, the listings of the shares of Amplats, PPRust and Leplats on Johannesburg Stock Exchange and the listing of PPRust and Leplats on the London Stock Exchange will be terminated.
Rusplats (RPH) will be renamed Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd.
Subject to shareholder approval, the RPH shares held by Amplats are to be distributed to Amplats shareholders in the ratio of 24.096 RPH shares for every 100 Amplats shares held.
Simultaneously, RPH will issue RPH shares as follows:
- 46 RPH shares for every 100 Amplats held;
- 41 RPH shares for every 100 PPRust held;
- six RPH shares for every 100 Leplats held.
